xb:0x00024C30.what: Script command GetCurrentLanguage: copies the game's current language setting into a small result and returns it to the script.

xb:0x0002DDB0.what: Script command SetSubZone: tells the script object which subzone of the city it is in, passing the script's argument to the object's own setter.

xb:0x0002E0F0.what: Script command GetClass: returns the name of the object's class, read from its class record.

xb:0x00070C60.what: Script command ltrim: returns the script's text with the spaces, tabs and line breaks at its start skipped.

xb:0x00070F70.what: Script command strlen: returns how many characters the script's text has.

xb:0x0008FC60.what: Script command AddMemoryHack: sets aside one 256-byte block of memory, if it has not already.

xb:0x0008FC90.what: Script command RemoveMemoryHack: frees the block of memory AddMemoryHack set aside, if there is one.

xb:0x000CED60.what: Script command NISIsPlaying: returns whether an in-game cutscene (NIS) is playing right now.

xb:0x000EB620.what: Script command ToggleFreezeGame: switches the game's freeze flag on if it was off and off if it was on.

xb:0x00178250.what: Script command CharacterObject::IsMainCharacter: returns 1 when the character is the player's main character (Tony), 0 otherwise.

xb:0x00179050.what: Script command CharacterObject::GetCharacterTemplate: returns the id of the template the character was made from, or 0 when it has none.

xb:0x00020960.what: Script command ActionMap::BindFunction: binds an input in the action map to a script function, from the script's three arguments.

xb:0x00024AC0.what: Script command GenerateFormattedNumericString: turns a number from the script into text using the format the script gives.

xb:0x00024AF0.what: Script command AllocateMemoryForPMGTextbibles: sets aside memory for the mission text banks, working in heap 5 while it does.

xb:0x00024B40.what: Script command SetTextbibleToSpecialLoad: marks a text bank, named by the script, to be loaded the special way the script asks.

xb:0x00024BB0.what: Script command GetNumTextbibleEntriesToLoad: returns how many text bank entries are waiting to load in the given slot, or 0 for a negative slot.

xb:0x00024D50.what: Script command FEBoxObject::SetTriPosition: sets where a menu box's pointer triangle sits from the two numbers the script passes.

xb:0x00024DC0.what: Script command FESpriteObject::SetCurrentItem: picks which picture a menu sprite shows, by the number the script passes.

xb:0x00026850.what: Script command Graph::SetMaxNumKeys: sets how many keys (points) a graph can hold, from the script's number.

xb:0x0002E040.what: Script command ScriptObject::SetDataField: sets one of the object's named data fields (the name is turned into its key) to the script's value.

xb:0x0002E0D0.what: Script command ScriptObject::GetParentGroup: returns the id of the group the object belongs to, or 0 when it is in none.

xb:0x00060760.what: Script command ResourceListLoad: starts loading the resource list whose number the script gives.

xb:0x00060780.what: Script command ResourceListRemove: unloads the resource list whose number the script gives.

xb:0x00060820.what: Script command LoadDZoneInCode: loads an interior's furniture zone (dzone), named by the script.

xb:0x00060840.what: Script command LoadAZoneInCode: loads an outdoor pocket zone (azone), named by the script.

xb:0x00060880.what: Script command GetResourceId: returns the id of the resource the script names, or -1 when there is no such resource.

xb:0x000608A0.what: Script command GetInventoryId: returns the id of the inventory item the script names, or -1 when there is no such item.

xb:0x00068A00.what: Script command ExecScript: runs a script file from the script's first two arguments, with an optional third when the script passes one.

xb:0x00068D10.what: Script command Cancel: cancels the scheduled script event whose number the script gives.

xb:0x00068D30.what: Script command IsEventPending: checks whether the scheduled script event whose number the script gives is still waiting to run.

xb:0x00070D60.what: Script command eval: compiles and runs the script text it is given.

xb:0x00070D80.what: Script command deleteVariables: removes the global script variables whose names match the pattern the script gives.

xb:0x00070E80.what: Script command GetNewObjectParentGroup: returns the id of the group new script objects are put in, or 0 when there is none.

xb:0x00070E90.what: Script command GetLastRootObject: returns the id of the last object made at the top of the object tree, or 0 when there is none.

xb:0x00077210.what: Script command SoundGetPOIConversationCompleteStatus: checks whether a point-of-interest conversation, by number, has finished.

xb:0x0008FB10.what: Script command PushStreamerObjectOfInterest: adds the object whose id the script gives to the ones the world streaming loads around.

xb:0x0008FB30.what: Script command PopStreamerObjectOfInterest: takes the object whose id the script gives off the ones the world streaming loads around.

xb:0x0008FC40.what: Script command GetSubzoneName: gets the name of the city subzone whose number the script gives.

xb:0x000CA030.what: Script command SaveGameController::CanWeSave: asks the save game controller whether saving is allowed now, for the slot number the script gives.

xb:0x000CA070.what: Script command SaveGameController::ActivateQueue: starts the save game controller's queued work, from the two numbers the script passes.

xb:0x000EB600.what: Script command FreezeGame: freezes or unfreezes the game, by the true or false the script passes.

xb:0x000EEB00.what: Script command DBChangeProduct: changes the player's amount of product (drugs) by the number the script gives.

xb:0x000EEB20.what: Script command DBChangeVehicleProduct: changes the amount of product carried in the vehicle by the number the script gives.

xb:0x000EEB40.what: Script command DBChangeCleanCash: changes the player's clean (banked) cash by the number the script gives.

xb:0x000EEB60.what: Script command DBChangeDirtyCash: changes the player's dirty cash by the number the script gives.

xb:0x000EEB80.what: Script command DBChangeReputationPoints: changes the player's reputation points, from the two numbers the script passes.

xb:0x000EEBF0.what: Script command DBSetTotalSkilledPoints: sets the player's total skill points to the number the script gives.

xb:0x000EEC10.what: Script command DBSetTotalMissionPoints: sets the player's total mission points to the number the script gives.

xb:0x000EEC30.what: Script command DBSetTotalExoticsPoints: sets the player's total exotics points to the number the script gives.

xb:0x000EEC80.what: Script command DBSetReputationLevel: sets the player's reputation level to the number the script gives.

xb:0x00115300.what: Script command HenchmanManager_SetFollowTony: turns on or off whether Tony's henchmen follow him, by the true or false the script passes.

xb:0x001199E0.what: Script command AIStimulusTable::DefineDefaultOverrideTables: sets up the AI stimulus table's default override tables from the script's argument.

xb:0x00119A00.what: Script command AIStimulusTable::DetectsStimulus: makes the AI stimulus table react to the stimulus whose number the script gives.

xb:0x00119A20.what: Script command AIStimulusTable::AddBasicEvent: adds a basic event to the AI stimulus table, from the two numbers the script passes.

xb:0x0011CED0.what: Script command NME_SetDefinedTunablesCount: sets how many tunable values the NME manager has, from the script's number.

xb:0x0011CF00.what: Script command NME_AddDefinedTunables: adds a tunable value to the NME manager, from the script's two arguments.
